title: MACLA contrastive refinement of a rule
shows: rule_7 has now been shown in enough won and lost games since its last refinement. The model compares them and rewrites the rule as one tighter rule (an exclusion goes into the condition); the log records `refine`.
why_interesting: The mechanism that changes rule text over time; also why recipe text can oscillate (see library/snapshots/evolution-study-E.md).

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When an object must be picked up and placed: search cabinets first, take the object, go to the target, open the target if closed, move the object there.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.example: search cabinet 1, take handtowel 1 from handtowelholder 1, go to cabinet 1, open cabinet 1, move handtowel 1 to cabinet 1
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.validation: This game confirmed the agent did not need to open the target container before moving the object. | This game shows the agent searched cabinet 1 first, not drawers, and moved the object directly to the target without opening it. | This game shows the agent must open the target cabinet before moving the object into it.

retries.reflection: I repeatedly navigated between desk 1 and drawers without opening the drawer first, then finally opened drawer 1 and moved the pencil to it. Instead of opening the drawer before attempting to move the pencil, I should have opened drawer 1 immediately upon reaching it to ensure the drawer was accessible. I should have opened drawer 1 before moving the pencil to it.
